Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

Responsibilities
1. AI Products: Work as a core member on company-level AI initiatives, from concept to launch — covering industry research, product definition, prototype review, user testing, and post-launch data analysis.
2. Defi (Stablecoin) Products: Track market trends, leading competitors, and on-chain data; produce decision-ready research memos. Contribute to product design, write PRDs, follow projects through development and launch, and support early-stage ecosystem partnership conversations.
3. Cross-Functional Proeject Management: Act as a key coordinator across multiple parallel workstreams — driving alignment on goals, pacing, and risks to keep complex projects on track.
4. Decision Support: Help produce internal and external materials, bilingual (CN/EN) writing and translation, and industry/data insights that feed directly into business decisions.
5. Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, etc.) as a daily working habit to scale personal output.

Requirements

1. Currently enrolled in Finance or Computer Science (or related); senior undergrad or graduate students preferred. Dual-degree (Finance + CS / AI) is a plus.
2. Fully bilingual in Chinese and English — able to write memos, emails, and meeting notes independently in both languages and switch fluently in bilingual settings.
3. Genuine interest and basic understanding. Hands-on trading or on-chain experience preferred — able to clearly articulate what you've used and the reasoning behind your decisions.
4. Active interest and hands-on exploration in AI, with demonstrable personal projects, demos, writing, or GitHub work. Background in HCI or big-data analytics is a plus.
5. Self-directed and structured — able to break down ambiguous problems and move forward independently, with consistent output in a fast-paced environment.
6. Strong communication and coordination skills — able to keep information and progress flowing across multiple teams.

Nice to Have

1. Entrepreneurial experience, leadership in student organizations, or large-scale event coordination.
2. Prior internships at top tech companies, financial institutions, or Web3 projects.
3. Public research or writing output (industry reports, in-depth posts, newsletters, etc.).
4. Your own perspective on the Defi space or major crypto products.

Why Binance

• Shape the future of finance
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

By submitting a job application, you acknowledge that you have read our Candidate Privacy Notice.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
